thread:
Sanjay: Heads up — our weekly RFC deep-dive is showing up as two separate series for some folks after Kevin updated the timezone. EMEA sees a separate event at 17:00 CET in addition to the regular 09:00 PT series. Anyone else?
Maria: Yep, I'm getting duplicate invites — one has the old Zoom link, the other has a new meeting code. Makes RSVP + agenda tracking messy.
calendar-bot: Notice: Event 'RFC deep-dive' updated by Kevin (series changed). Participants: 18 added, 2 removed.
Kevin: Sorry, I tried to fix the timezone on the series and must've created a new recurring series instead of editing the original. My bad.
Emily: That explains why some attendees see two entries in their calendar and others just one. For the agenda, we should still be able to keep the canonical doc: https://docs.internal/redwood/rfc-deep-dive/agenda — please don't edit until we merge.
Lisa: Quick impact note: triage rotation folks in APAC missed last week's action items because their calendar showed the older instance (different Zoom).
Kevin: Plan: I'd like to merge/remove the duplicate series and keep one canonical event with the original meeting link. Can we agree on steps before I proceed?
Maria: SGTM but please create the new series in the same time zone as the original (Pacific) and use 'Only update this series' not 'This and following'.
Emily: Also, can we make the invite use a static meeting link (no one-off codes) so on-call/rotation members can always join the same URL?
Kevin: Yep. In Google Calendar that's: 1) open one of the duplicate events -> Manage event -> More actions -> Delete -> Choose 'This and following' carefully (don't break old exceptions). 2) Recreate a single series with the correct timezone and the original static Zoom link. 3) Use 'Find a time' to check overlaps. If you want a quick command-ish checklist:```1. Identify event IDs (open details -> copy link)
2. Export ICS of both series (three-dot menu -> Download)`
3. Compare RRULEs and exceptions (EXDATE)
4. Delete the incorrect series (use 'only this instance' for exceptions, 'entire series' otherwise)
5. Recreate/paste canonical link and resend invites```
Lisa: Anything we can do to avoid this happening again? The rrule/EXDATE stuff is easy to mess up in UI.
Kevin: Two follow-ups: 1) I'll add a short ops doc with the exact steps and screenshots. 2) We should prefer 'static meeting' templates for recurring calls (ops-managed Zoom room or Google Meet link).
Maria: To decide whether to recreate now or later: can folks in EMEA make the Thu slot (09:00 PT / 17:00 CET) or do we want to try a slightly later UTC-friendly time? React with emoji: :one: for keep (09:00 PT / 17:00 CET), :two: for shift to 11:00 PT / 19:00 CET, :three: for propose alternatives in thread.
Sanjay: Add agenda housekeeping: please add 1-line topic bullets to the agenda doc before Tuesday COB so we can triage items during the triage portion.
Emily: I'll lock the agenda template and add a short header about meeting link policy (static link required).
calendar-bot: Poll posted: reactions will be recorded for 48 hours.
Kevin: I'll wait 24h for reactions, then clean up duplicates and update the series (I'll ping here before deleting to give a last-chance heads-up).
Maria: Thanks — appreciate the plan. Also cc @PlatformEng — we should add this to onboarding doc about recurring invites.
Sanjay: Perfect. Small ask: when you edit the series, please paste the canonical Zoom link in the first post of the thread so it shows in emails too.
Kevin: Will do and will drop a quick screenshot of the deletion choice so folks know which option to pick. :thumbsup:
